items.label: burnconfig
items.doc: Schedule a calibration write to flash once the engine is stopped.

items.label: curve
items.doc:
Looks up a value from the specified Script Curve.

- Parameters
  - `tableIdx`: Index of the script to use, starting from 1.
  - `x`: Axis value to look up in the table

items.label: enableCanTx
items.doc:
Enabled by default

Use enableCanTx(false) to suppress CAN TX

items.label: findCurveIndex
items.doc: Finds curve index by specific curve name

items.label: findSetting
items.doc:
Find the User Setting with the specified name and returns the numeric value. Useful when the script developer and script consumer are different people; also useful while Lua script editing is available only in TS.

- Parameters
  - `name`: Variable name, as in corresponding 'name' field in configuration
  - `defaultValue`: value to use if specified setting not located by name

items.label: findTableIndex
items.doc: Find table index by specified human-readable name.

items.label: getAuxAnalog
items.doc:
More or less like getSensorRaw but always voltage of aux analog input.

- Parameters
  - `index`: Index of aux analog sensor to read. From 0 to 3

- Returns
  - Voltage of sensor reading, or nil if sensor isn't configured.

items.label: getAuxDigital
items.doc:
Reads a digital input from the configurable list.

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the digital pin to read. Valid values are 0 through 7, one for each of the 8 user-defined digital pins. See "Lua Digital Aux Inputs" table under "Advanced" settings tab.

- Returns
  - A boolean value representing the state of the input pin. `true` = high voltage (above ~2 volts), `false` = low voltage (below ~3 volts)

items.label: getCalibration
items.doc:
Gets current calibration value for a specified scalar setting. For example: `getCalibration("cranking.rpm")`

For complete list of possible calibration names (valid parameter values) and descriptions, see the generated lookup table.

items.label: getDigital
items.doc:
Reads a digital input from the specified channel.

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the digital channel to read. See table below for values.

- Returns
  - A boolean value representing the state of the input pin. `true` = high voltage (above ~2 volts), `false` = low voltage (below ~3 volts)

Valid `index` parameter values:

items.label: getGpPwm
items.doc:
Gets current PWM of GPPWM by index

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the PWM channel to set. Valid values are 0 through 3.

- Returns
  - PWM percent, 0 to 100

items.label: getOutput
items.doc:
For example `getOutput("clutchUpState")` or `getOutput("brakePedalState")`

See https://github.com/rusefi/rusefi/blob/master/firmware/controllers/lua/generated/output_lookup_generated.cpp for output names.

items.label: getSensor
items.doc:
Reads the specified sensor. For instance `getSensor("AcceleratorPedal")`

- Parameters
  - `name`: Name of the sensor to read. A list of sensor names can be found here.

- Returns
  - A reading from the sensor, or `nil` if the sensor has a problem or isn't configured.

items.label: getSensorByIndex
items.doc:
Reads the specified sensor.

- Parameters
  - `index`: Index of the sensor to read. A list of sensor indices can be found here.

- Returns
  - A reading from the sensor, or `nil` if the sensor has a problem or isn't configured.

items.label: getSensorRaw
items.doc:
Reads the raw value from the specified sensor. For most sensors, this means the analog voltage on the relevant input pin.

- Parameters
  - `index`: Index of the sensor to read. A list of sensor indices can be found here.

- Returns
  - The raw value that yielded the sensor reading, or 0 if the sensor doesn't support raw readings, isn't configured, or has failed.

items.label: getTsButtonCount
items.doc:
`getTsButtonCount X` returns number of times specific Lua button was pressed in TS

See ts-button-example.lua

items.label: hasSensor
items.doc:
Checks whether a particular sensor is configured (whether it is currently valid or not).

- Parameters
  - `index`: Index of the sensor to check. A list of sensor indices can be found here.

- Returns
  - A boolean value, `true` if the sensor is configured, and `false` if not.

items.label: IndustrialPid.new
items.doc: Create an industrial PID controller.

items.label: interpolate
items.doc: Interpolates `x` placing it on the line defined by (x1, y1) and (x2, y2)

items.label: isEngineStopRequested
items.doc: Returns true if engine stop was requested by either Lua or a start/stop button within the last five seconds.

items.label: isFirmwareError
items.doc: Returns true if the ECU is in state of critical/fatal error.

items.label: mcu_standby
items.doc: Stops MCU.

items.label: onCanRx
items.doc: Default CAN RX callback when canRxAdd is used without a custom callback.

items.label: onTick
items.doc: Called periodically by rusEFI.

items.label: Pid.new
items.doc: Create a PID controller.

items.label: print
items.doc:
Print a line of text to the ECU's log.

- Parameters
  - `msg`: The message to print. Pass a string or number and it will be printed to the log.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: readPin
items.doc:
Reads physical value of arbitrary MCU pin in case of emergency. Not a proper way to implement proper logic, use Lua aux inputs.

- Parameters
  - `pinName`: string name of MCU pin, for examples "PD15"

items.label: selfStimulateRPM
items.doc: Positive value would start clicking injectors at specified RPM, zero value would stop self-stimulation.

items.label: Sensor:set
items.doc: Set sensor value.

items.label: Sensor:setTimeout
items.doc: Sensor validity timeout, ms.

items.label: Sensor.new
items.doc: Create a virtual sensor.

items.label: setAcDisabled
items.doc: Disable/suppress A/C functionality regardless of how it is enabled.

items.label: setAcRequestState
items.doc: Use `setAcRequestState` to tell rusEFI about a CAN-based A/C request.

items.label: setBoostDutyAdd
items.doc: Additive for open loop target boost pressure.

items.label: setBoostTargetAdd
items.doc: Additive for closed loop target boost pressure.

items.label: setBoostTargetMult
items.doc: Multiplier for closed loop target boost pressure.

items.label: setBrakePedalState
items.doc: Use `setBrakePedalState` to tell rusEFI about a CAN-based brake pedal.

items.label: setCalibration
items.doc:
Sets the specified calibration setting to the specified value. Fires a calibration change event depending on the needEvent parameter.

For example: `setCalibration("cranking.rpm", 900, false)`

items.label: setDacVoltage
items.doc: Not enabled on most boards since most boards were not developer with DAC in mind! See https://github.com/rusefi/rusefi/blob/master/firmware/controllers/lua/examples/dac.txt for more info.

items.label: setDebug
items.doc:
Sets a debug channel to the specified value. Note: this only works when the ECU debug mode is set to `Lua`.

- Parameters
  - `index`: the index of the debug channel to set, 1 thru 7 inclusive.
  - `value`: the value to set the channel to

- Returns
  - none

items.label: setEtbAdd
items.doc:
Amount of ETB to add, as a percent of the wide-open value: e.g. `10` for +10%. The value is a static amount to add to the determined value, e.g. TPS of 5% w/ `10` results in 15% ETB.

This could be used for torque reduction.

items.label: setFuelAdd
items.doc:
Currently not functional

Amount of fuel mass to add to injection, scaled by fuel multiplier (`setFuelMult()`); initially 0.

items.label: setFuelMult
items.doc:
Currently not functional

Amount to scale added fuel mass by; initially 1.0;

items.label: setIdleAdd
items.doc: Percent to add to idle (incl. open loop).

items.label: setIgnDisabled
items.doc: Use `setIgnDisabled` for all kinds of cranking safety systems.

items.label: setLuaGauge
items.doc:
In an ideal world one would be using Sensor.new("LuaGauge1") but looks like that's not the way at the moment :(

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the Lua gauge to set. Valid indices are from '1' to '8'.
  - `value`: Desired gauge value.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: setPwmDuty
items.doc:
Set the duty cycle of the specified PWM channel.

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the PWM channel to set. Valid values are 0 through 7, one for each of the 8 channels.
  - `duty`: Desired duty cycle of the output. `0.0` = fully off, and `1.0` = fully on. `0.25` = on 25% of the time, off 75% of the time.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: setPwmFreq
items.doc:
- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the PWM channel to set.
  - `frequency`: Initial frequency of the output, in hertz (cycles per second). Valid values are between 1 and 1000hz.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: setSparkHardSkipRatio
items.doc: `setSparkHardSkipRatio(0)` to skip 0% of the ignition events, i.e. no skipping `setSparkHardSkipRatio(0.75)` would skip 75% of ignition events.

items.label: setSparkSkipRatio
items.doc:
`setSparkSkipRatio(0)` woild skip 0% of the ignition events, i.e. no skipping `setSparkSkipRatio(0.5)` would skip half of ignition events. We never skip two consecutive ignitions.

This could be used for torque reduction.

items.label: setTickRate
items.doc:
Sets the rate at which rusEFI calls your `onTick` and `onCanRx` functions, in hz. On reset default is 10hz.

- Parameters
  - `hz`: Desired tick rate, in hz. Values passed will be clamped to a minimum of 1hz, and maximum of 200hz.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: setTimingAdd
items.doc: Use negative values to retard timing.

items.label: setTimingMult
items.doc: This could be used for torque reduction.

items.label: startCrankingEngine
items.doc: Start cranking as if a physical start button was tapped.

items.label: startPwm
items.doc:
Initializes PWM on the specified index, starting at the specified frequency and duty cycle. The index selects which config field pin to use, see "Lua PWM Outputs" page in TunerStudio.

- Parameters
  - `index`: The index of the PWM channel to start. Valid values are 0 through 7, one for each of the 8 channels.
  - `frequency`: Initial frequency of the output, in hertz (cycles per second). Valid values are between 1 and 1000hz.
  - `duty`: Initial duty cycle of the output. `0.0` = fully off, and `1.0` = fully on. `0.25` = on 25% of the time, off 75% of the time.

- Returns
  - none

items.label: table3d
items.doc:
Looks up a value from the specified Script Table.

- Parameters
  - `tableIdx`: Index of the table to use. Currently 4 tables are supported, so indices 1, 2, 3, and 4 are valid.
  - `x`: X-axis value to look up in the table (this is often RPM)
  - `y`: Y-axis value to look up in the table (this is often load)

- Returns
  - A number representing the value looked up from the table.

items.label: Timer:getElapsedSeconds
items.doc: `yourTimer:getElapsedSeconds();` to get number of seconds since timer was reset

items.label: Timer:reset
items.doc: `yourTimer:reset();` to reset timer

items.label: Timer.new
items.doc: Create a Timer instance.

items.label: txCan
items.doc:
- Parameters
  - bus: hardware CAN bus index, only '1' on most rusEFI boards, '1' or '2' on Proteus, '1-2-3' on uaCanBridge and purple gateway
  - isExt: 0 for 11 bit mode

items.label: vin
items.doc:
Return VIN setting character at specified index

- Parameters
  - index: zero-based index
